title: General Purpose Chairs and Stools - Specification
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements for general purpose chairs and stools. This standard applies to completely manufactured/fabricated general purpose chairs and stools. It also applies to ready-to-assemble units; in that case the requirements of this standard shall apply to the assembled units.
